title: The Cup and the Prayer
summary: Moroni records the manner of administering the wine: an unnamed group took the cup and addressed God in prayer, asking that the wine be blessed and sanctified for those who drink in remembrance of his Son.

explicit_facts.text: An unnamed group took the cup and spoke.
The prayer addresses God, the Eternal Father, in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ.
The prayer asks that the wine be blessed and sanctified to the souls of those who drink it in remembrance of the blood of God's Son, shed for them.
The prayer asks that those who drink witness that they always remember God's Son, that they may have his Spirit with them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A cup may serve as a visual focus for the recorded manner of administration.
unspecified_visual_details: The group's number, identities, offices, clothing, and appearance are unspecified.
The setting and the cup's material, size, and design are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee, in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this wine to the souls of all those who drink of it,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Unnamed group administering the wine

spoken_dialogue.text: that they do always remember him, that they may have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.

narration.text: Behold, they took the cup, and said:

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Preserve this as Moroni's report of the manner of administering wine, not a newly invented present-tense ceremony.
Moroni is the narrator, not an identified participant in the reported administration.
The dialogue excerpts are portions of the supplied prayer, not its complete text.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify the unnamed group as elders or priests.
Do not invent individual speakers or assign the prayer to Moroni.
Do not depict God, Jesus Christ, or the Spirit as visibly present.
Do not depict the shedding of Christ's blood as an event in this scene.
Do not add drinking, distribution of wine, or a visible answer to the prayer; these actions are not narrated.
